reference.title: Heart explant reference gallery (cardiomyopathies & myocarditis)
reference.intro: Open-licence photomicrographs and key diagnostic criteria for cardiac amyloidosis, giant cell myocarditis, lymphocytic myocarditis, HCM, ACM and cardiac allograft vasculopathy.

groups.heading: Cardiac amyloidosis
points: Extracellular amorphous eosinophilic pericellular/interstitial and vascular deposits compressing myocytes
Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence under polarised light; always type (ATTR vs AL) by IHC or mass spectrometry

images.caption: Cardiac amyloidosis — extracellular fluffy eosinophilic amyloid surrounding atrophic myocytes with lipofuscin (H&E, high mag).
Cardiac amyloidosis — salmon-pink interstitial amyloid deposits on Congo red stain (intermediate mag).

groups.heading: Giant cell myocarditis vs lymphocytic myocarditis
points: Giant cell myocarditis: diffuse mixed inflammatory infiltrate (lymphocytes, eosinophils, macrophages) with prominent multinucleated giant cells and extensive myocyte necrosis, without well-formed non-necrotising granulomas (distinguish from cardiac sarcoidosis)
Lymphocytic myocarditis: interstitial T-lymphocytic infiltrate closely associated with myocyte necrosis/damage

images.caption: Giant cell myocarditis — diffuse mixed inflammatory infiltrate with multinucleated giant cells and myocyte necrosis (H&E).
images.credit: Takei et al., JA Clin Rep 2016 (PMC5813737), Wikimedia Commons

images.caption: Lymphocytic myocarditis — interstitial lymphocytic infiltrate with focal myocyte necrosis (H&E, annotated).

groups.heading: HCM, ACM & Cardiac Allograft Vasculopathy (criteria)
points: HCM: extensive myocyte disarray (>10% of myocardium), myocyte hypertrophy with boxcar nuclei, interstitial fibrosis and intramural small-vessel dysplasia
ACM (ARVC): transmural fibrofatty replacement progressing from epicardium to endocardium in RV (and/or LV) with residual myocyte islands

CAV (re-transplant): diffuse concentric fibrointimal hyperplasia of epicardial and intramyocardial coronary arteries with intact internal elastic lamina, distinct from eccentric calcific native atherosclerosis

snippets.label: Genetic counselling note (HCM / ACM / DCM)
snippets.text: Given the histopathological diagnosis, clinical genetics referral and cascade family screening may be considered if not already performed.

snippets.label: Amyloid typing note (mass spectrometry / IHC)
snippets.text: Definitive amyloid subtyping (ATTR vs AL) by immunohistochemistry and/or laser microdissection–tandem mass spectrometry is recommended to guide systemic management.

snippets.label: Failed cardiac allograft DSA correlation
snippets.text: Correlation with donor-specific HLA antibodies (DSA) and pre-retransplant coronary angiography is recommended.
